task_contract.prompt: On Linux, preserve Dot's default-off persistent show-song-info option. With long artist and title metadata at normal and maximum text size, information must remain visible inside the hero without clipping or intersecting the centered pulsing dot. Provide screenshots at both scales.

scorecard.note: Fresh state (empty queue, no track, no prior toggle) shows the pulsing dot alone with no artist/title overlay at all -- default-off preserved.

The showSongInfo boolean does persist across restart (hero-artist/hero-song nodes exist in the tree only when true), but the rendered result is a live Flutter ErrorWidget crash ("Invalid argument(s): 0.0"), not a working overlay -- toggle state and actual rendered overlay disagree, which is E2's own falsification clause.
After disabling the option and restarting, the Dot hero shows the dot alone, no overlay, no error -- the off state round-trips cleanly (this path skips the buggy radius clamp entirely).

At 100% text size with the long-metadata track (artist 80 chars, title 99 chars) playing and the option on, the screenshot shows a red Flutter error screen ("Invalid argument(s): 0.0") overlapping the title text; the dot itself never renders because the fix's own radius clamp throws when the reserved-title-height exceeds half the hero height.
At 150% text size, same setup: the screenshot shows the identical crash/ErrorWidget overlapping the title -- this is the exact regression scenario the task exists to fix, and it is not fixed.

No candidate screenshot exists among the deliverables at all: agent_shots=0 in collect.json, zero PNGs anywhere under artifacts/, and the candidate's own transcript contains zero invocations of drive.py or drive.py shoot (it never launched the live app; its only artifact is a synthetic flutter_test golden render). My own fresh reproduction at 100% also shows the crash.

Same as E6: no candidate max-scale screenshot deliverable exists anywhere, and my own fresh reproduction just now (right before deciding) at 150% still shows the same ErrorWidget crash live in the container.

Structural reads at both scales (tree dumps) show the hero-artist/hero-song Text nodes with real non-empty resolved text and non-zero font sizes (45.0/22.5 at 150%, matching values at 100%) -- the text layer itself is genuinely rendering; it is the dot's own AnimatedBuilder subtree that throws and gets replaced by an ErrorWidget alongside it.

Playing an ordinary short-metadata fixture track ("undercover") with the option on reproduces the identical ErrorWidget crash -- the fix broke the common case, not just the long-metadata edge case; scored per this expectation's own falsification ceiling for a layout regression introduced by the fix.

The container's live flutter run log shows "Another exception was thrown: Invalid argument(s): 0.0" repeating continuously (still reproducing at decide time) every time showSongInfo is on, tied directly to this feature's new radius-clamp code; the app stays responsive to driving overall, but new error entries tied to this area are unambiguous.
